Package com.neueda.leap.onboarding.dto

Record Class UserResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.onboarding.dto.UserResponse
Record Components:
id - the unique identifier of the user
firstName - the user's first name
lastName - the user's last name
dateOfBirth - the user's date of birth
email - the user's email address
phone - the user's phone number
accountType - the selected account type
traderLevel - the selected trader level
emailVerified - whether the user's email address has been verified
createdAt - the timestamp when the user was created
updatedAt - the timestamp when the user was last updated
public record UserResponse(UUID id, String firstName, String lastName, LocalDate dateOfBirth, String email, String phone, AccountType accountType, TraderLevel traderLevel, boolean emailVerified, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt) extends Record
Response DTO representing the public user data returned by the API.
